---
title: "Journeys through this playbook"
description: "The same work seen from four seats: where each role goes, in what order, and what each stop leaves behind."
---

Nobody reads all fifteen sections. These four journeys are the order the sections come at you if you
are the analyst, the commissioner, the critical friend or the Analysis Senior Responsible Officer.

Each one has the same columns: where you are, the section that answers it, what you do there, and
what you leave behind. **Read the last column on its own and it is the evidence trail for one piece
of analysis.** A stop that leaves nothing behind is a stop nobody can evidence, which is the test a
stop had to pass to be on these diagrams at all.

[Section 3](../03-roles-and-responsibilities/index.qmd) defines the four roles and says what each is
accountable for. This page is where they go.
